a: Profiles enable optional services for different environments.
Compose watch can sync files and rebuild on changes.
Cache mounts speed dependency installs during builds.
Attestations document how an image was built.
Content trust verifies signed images when enabled.
User namespaces can map container root to unprivileged host users.
Seccomp profiles restrict system calls containers may make.
MAC systems add mandatory access controls for containers.
Logging drivers control where container logs are sent.
An init process reaps zombies inside containers.
